name: gaussianedit-orchestration
description: Safely coordinates GaussianEdit development through its authenticated board and immutable cloud handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate local and cloud GaussianEdit work safely.
interface.longDescription: Reads the authenticated GaussianEdit board, enforces fail-closed single-job dispatch, and coordinates immutable handoffs between local Codex work and cloud workers.
defaultPrompt: Use $dispatch-cloud-work to dispatch at most one safely eligible GaussianEdit job.
Check the GaussianEdit board and return NOOP when no cloud handoff is eligible.
